Are you technically minded, precise, and motivated by building complex technical products? For ASML in Veldhoven, we are looking for multiple Assemblers who want to work on some of the most advanced technology in the world. As an Assembler, you will be responsible for accurately assembling, testing, and manufacturing complex modules and components. You will work according to technical drawings, work instructions, and established quality standards, with quality and precision always being your top priorities. You will work in a clean, high-tech production environment where precision, teamwork, and continuous improvement are key. It is an environment where your technical skills directly contribute to the quality and reliability of the products. Wie zoeken we? You are someone who works carefully and with a high level of concentration and enjoys assembling technical products. You have a strong eye for detail and understand that even the smallest deviation can be important when working with complex high-tech products. You are also a true team player. You communicate clearly, are open to feedback, and are willing to support your colleagues when needed. You take ownership of your work and do not hesitate to act when you identify a problem. You are eager to learn and motivated to further develop your technical skills within a high-tech environment. Because you may work with different products and activities, you are flexible and able to switch easily between tasks. What you bring MBO Level 3 or 4, preferably in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable technical field. Experience in a technical production or assembly environment. Experience assembling and testing electronic and/or mechatronic components. Experience working with hand tools such as torque wrenches, pliers, and precision tools. Ability to work with technical drawings and work instructions. Basic knowledge of electrical principles, such as resistance, induction, andhigh-voltage testing, is an advantage. Good command of the English language, both written and spoken. Conversational command of the Dutch language is an advantage. Experience working in a cleanroom or contamination-controlled environment is an advantage. Excellent fine motor skills and the ability to work with a high level of precision. Wat bieden wij je? As an Assembler at ASML, you will have the opportunity to work in one of the most innovative high-tech manufacturing environments in the world. You will receive an extensive onboarding program and the necessary training and guidance to become familiar with the work, products, and processes. In addition, we offer: A full-time position of 40 hours per week. A temporary assignment of 12 months. A day shift position. A gross monthly salary of up to €3,400, excluding bonus and holiday allowance. 27 days of paid annual leave. 13 ADV (working time reduction) days. A 13th-month salary, paid annually. An annual bonus based on the company's results. Extensive onboarding, training, and opportunities for further development. The opportunity to work in an international and highly innovative high-tech environment. Be Part of the Impact ASML develops and manufactures the world's most advanced lithography systems. These machines are used to produce the chips that form the foundation of virtually all modern technology. From smartphones and computers to cars and medical equipment, ASML's technology plays an important role in our everyday lives. As an Assembler, you are part of that impact. With your precision and craftsmanship, you ensure that complex modules are assembled and tested according to the highest quality standards. Every module you assemble contributes to the technology that enables the future of the semiconductor industry. Your work. Your craftsmanship. Your contribution to the technology of tomorrow. Are you an experienced technician who enjoys solving technical challenges in a highly automated environment? Do you have a strong background in electrical and mechanical maintenance and would you like to work with advanced logistics systems? Then this could be your next opportunity. For ASML Technical Support – Warehouse, we are looking for a Service Technician to strengthen the team. In this role, you will help ensure the optimal operation, availability, and reliability of automated warehouse systems and intralogistics equipment. You will work in a high-tech environment where automation, precision, safety, and continuous improvement are essential. Together with your colleagues, you will make sure that ASML's logistics operations continue to run efficiently and with minimal downtime. Wie zoeken we? You are a hands-on technician who enjoys working in a dynamic and highly automated environment. You approach technical problems in a structured way and remain calm when equipment unexpectedly stops or priorities change. Rather than simply solving the immediate issue, you look for the underlying cause and consider how similar problems can be prevented in the future. Because you will work closely with internal and external customers, colleagues, and suppliers, clear communication is essential. You are able to explain technical issues in an understandable way and understand the importance of good service. You take ownership of your responsibilities, work well as part of a team, and are always looking for ways to improve processes and equipment. You are curious and willing to keep learning as technology and processes develop. You are proactive, well organized, and understand that safety and quality should never be compromised. Technical skills Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent relevant work experience. Proven experience in industrial maintenance. Practical knowledge of electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic systems. Ability to read andinterpret electrical circuit diagrams and technical assembly drawings. Demonstrated experience with troubleshooting and fault finding. Experience with preventive and corrective maintenance. Experience with predictive maintenance and/or automated systems is an advantage. Strong awareness of safety and quality standards. Good command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken. Wat bieden wij je? As a Service Technician at ASML, you will work in a highly automated and technologically advanced environment where you can further develop your technical expertise. You will have the opportunity to work with complex equipment, learn from experienced colleagues, and build a long-term career within one of the world's leading high-tech companies. You can expect: A gross monthly salary of €4,220, excluding shift allowance. 25.1% shift allowance for all hours worked in a two-shift schedule. A 13th-month salary. An annual bonus based on company results. 27 days of paid annual leave. Long-term career and development opportunities. The opportunity to work with advanced automated systems in a high-tech environment. Be Part of the Impact ASML develops and manufactures the world's most advanced lithography systems. These systems are essential for producing the microchips that power modern technology. Behind this highly complex production process is a sophisticated logistics operation that ensures the right components and materials are available at the right place and at the right time. As a Service Technician, you are an essential part of that operation. By keeping automated warehouse systems and intralogistics equipment running reliably, you directly contribute to the continuity of ASML's production process. Your work may happen behind the scenes, but its impact is significant: you help keep the technology of tomorrow moving today.
